event: CO2 falls below ~150 ppm; C3 photosynthesis fails
notes: Caldeira & Kasting 1992. Most trees, wheat, rice. Graham et al. 2024 revise the floor to 2.9 ppm, which alone shows these are parameters not constants.

event: C4 grasses and relatives dominate what remains of land flora
notes: CO2-concentrating mechanisms become the only viable strategy.

event: Selection pressure for better CCMs intensifies
notes: C4 evolved 66+ times under exactly this pressure. Proto-Kranz and C2 intermediates are the known path.
Ozaki & Reinhard 2021: 1.08 +/- 0.14 Gyr absolute, over ~10000 yr. Precedes this anchor.

event: Unshielded UV at the surface; land flora under compound stress
notes: No ozone. Heat, anoxia, carbon scarcity simultaneously.

event: CO2 crosses the ~10 ppm C4 threshold
notes: Nominal end of land primary production. Caldeira & Kasting bracket the range at 0.9-1.5 Gyr; Graham et al. put the strong-weathering endpoint at 1.35 Gyr.

event: Standard models: land is biologically sterile
notes: These models hold photosynthetic biology fixed at present-day parameters.

event: Evolution-assumed models: land persists to the thermal ceiling instead
notes: See ../58381561767225600. The binding constraint shifts from carbon to heat.
